title: SignAlgorithm — shared definition for the keys/* spec family
description: Canonical SignAlgorithm $def, shared by every keys/* specification that produces a signature. Not itself a Trust Task specification (the `_shared` folder is skipped by the registry build and the codegen).

SignAlgorithm.title: SignAlgorithm
SignAlgorithm.description: `EdDSA` pairs with an `ed25519` key; `ES256` pairs with a `p256` key. An `x25519` key performs key agreement and can sign nothing, so no algorithm here is valid for one. The enumeration is closed: an unrecognised algorithm is refused rather than silently substituted with a supported one.
